description: Round 4 of the full-parity phase (callables family, seeds 9201-9215, 30000 cases): template names that are not valid UTF-8 (`template_from_string(code, name)`) in the `templateName` of an error (minimised from c9205-00691m, 4 raw cases). Harness item T15: the oracle and twig-rs replace the invalid bytes differently; the controls are names both replace alike. Vectors with known_mismatch still differ; the others are controls that must stay identical. Recorded with "isolation": "process".

error.message: Block "" on template "?? (string template 99aa06d3014798d86001c324468d497f)" does not exist in "?? (string template 99aa06d3014798d86001c324468d497f)".
error.formatted: Twig\Error\RuntimeError: Block "" on template "?? (string template 99aa06d3014798d86001c324468d497f)" does not exist in "?? (string template 99aa06d3014798d86001c324468d497f)".
error.rawMessage: Block "" on template "?? (string template 99aa06d3014798d86001c324468d497f)" does not exist.

known_mismatch.reason: T15 (plans/parity-fixes.md, G6), harness, not a twig-rs bug: describe_throwable() (research/php-oracle/lib.php) writes `templateName` as it is instead of through put_string(), so the runner's json_encode(..., JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE) replaces the invalid bytes of the name with one U+FFFD per sequence PHP's decoder rejects (php_next_utf8_char() takes `\xed\xa0` and `\xe0\x80` as one sequence, PHPSRC/ext/standard/html.c:139). twig-rs converts the name lossily (accepted deviation "Non-UTF-8 template names given to template_from_string()", reference/deviations.md) with String::from_utf8_lossy(), which replaces maximal subparts: two U+FFFD here. The messages carry `message_b64` and compare equal. When the oracle sends `templateName_b64` and the diff compares the name the way it compares messages, refresh these vectors (twig-fuzz refresh) and replay --update flips them.
